items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Ray Nance was the guy who encouraged me to go with Lunceford... Ray and I were -- and Budd Johnson was on that band to.

ctx.x: How was it that Ray convinced you to make the change?
Well, I wasn't going, so Ray said I would go if I were you. He says because you get a better shot at things, which I did. You know, I'm glad he did. In fact,

Ray went to the -- Stanley Dance said he wrote that in a story. Ray went out to the station. I had to catch a train ride, oh man to New York. I hate to think about it now. A coach (Laughter) -- I was so tired when I got into New York.
